title: Kontablo Localization Mapping
description: Schema for localizations/<iso>/<standard>_mapping.yaml (dict format). v2 adds OPTIONAL structure-preservation fields (ADR-016): local_parent + local_hierarchy keep the local chart's own tree edges, facets name the analytical dimensions that the projection to a coarser Kontablo node would otherwise silently flatten, and aggregation_group declares N:1 fibers explicitly. All v2 fields are additive: every existing v1 file remains valid, and resolution behavior is unchanged (the Tier-1 index is built from the ontology, not from these files).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. MUST be quoted in YAML (bare NO parses as boolean).

local_hierarchy.description: OPTIONAL (v2). Header/class nodes of the LOCAL chart's own tree that are not themselves mappable accounts (e.g. SKR04 Kontenklassen, SPED groupings). Keyed by local code. Together with per-entry local_parent, this preserves the local tree edges that the flat mapping would otherwise discard.

local_parent.description: Parent code within local_hierarchy (the tree edge one level up).

mappings.description: local statutory code -> mapping entry. Keys MUST be strings (quote numeric codes in YAML).

local_parent.description: OPTIONAL (v2). The code of this account's parent in the LOCAL chart — either another mappings key or a local_hierarchy key. Preserves the local tree edge that the flat projection discards (loss L2, ADR-016).

facets.description: OPTIONAL (v2). Named analytical dimensions of this local account that the coarser Kontablo node does not encode (e.g. {geography: domestic}, {tax: icms}, {polarity: contra}). Formalizes the disaggregation_dimension idea; makes the flattened axis explicit and re-queryable instead of silently lost.

aggregation_group.description: OPTIONAL (v2). Shared identifier declaring an explicit N:1 fiber: all local codes carrying the same aggregation_group collapse into one Kontablo node by design (e.g. gross receivables + contra allowance -> net receivables node).
